title: Zephyrine and the Oath
author: Ivo Reyes
blurb: Noor Zhou, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
